README.md: Edit layout.json to rearrange this workspace’s decisions. Keep each named section once. To group sections, replace them in the list with {"display": "stack", "title": "For review", "sections": ["heading", "request"]}. Use columns for a side-by-side group on wide screens. Set cardLayout in client.js to compact or full. Tedix checks approval permissions for each answer. Publish the revision to update this workspace. In server.js, env.TEDIX.connectionsCall can call tools granted through a bound connection.
